title: KT Wiz to hold 2026 fan festival at Suwon with player events and band performances
text:
KT Wiz to hold 2026 fan festival at Suwon with player events and band performances - CHOSUNBIZ 
 2026년 11월 17일(화) Industry Finance Real Estate IT Retail Science Policy Society International Entertainment Culture Sports English Sports KT Wiz to hold 2026 fan festival at Suwon with player events and band performances 
 입력 2026.11.17. 14:10 조선비즈 구글 검색 먼저 보기 KT Wiz will hold a 2026 fan festival.
 KT said on the 17th, "We will hold the 2026 Fan Festival at Suwon KT Wiz Park on the 21st. This event was organized to thank fans for their support during the season and to provide time for communication."
 About 30 players, including KT captain Jang Sung-woo, and all rookie players for 2027 will attend the fan festival, and it will be organized into Part 1 and Part 2 as events that fans can directly participate in and enjoy.
 On the field, a 'play ground' experience zone will operate with attractions such as an air bounce, pitch-speed measurement and photo zones. A fan signing session and mini fan meetings will take place at the first-base dugout and on the field, and rookie players expected to join in 2027, including Lee Seung-won and Choi Ji-man, will create meaningful memories by offering live batting and one-point pitching lessons for child members.
 In Part 2, a 'kt wiz teeball tournament' with fans will take place. Ko Young-pyo, Kim Hyun-soo, Woo Kyu-min and Jang Sung-woo will act as managers and form four teams to play a tournament. Fans who join teams with players and the championship team will receive generous prizes.
 That day, the Yoon Do-hyun Band and the Lee Sang-hoon Band will perform to add to the event's energy.
 Meanwhile, a warm sharing event has also been prepared ahead of the year-end. A sponsorship fund of 10 million won, created from donations by KT Alpha Shopping and contributions saved according to the win totals of Ko Young-pyo and So Hyeong-jun, will be handed over to youth baseball teams. In cooperation with the Gyeonggi Provincial Government, proceeds of 10 million won from sales of the "2026 Bonggong-i uniform" will also be donated to the Firefighter Families Hope Sharing fund.
 Detailed event information is available on the club's official app, Wizzap.
